{{Top|leg}}
'''Loudest-howling''' was a sporting competition. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] and an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] fought a battle observed by a group of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|aliens]]. Misinterpreting the conflict as a sports contest, they were appalled at the uneven matchup between the two competitors. Stunning the crews of the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], the aliens took them aboard their [[fathership]] to continue the contest, while overseeing it as judges for their own entertainment. Loudest-howling was one of a number of competitions that the aliens proposed for the crews to compete in, along with [[free-style zero-G swimming]], [[acrobatic pyramids]], marksmanship, and [[zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase]]s.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
